resources.string: Location exports can include selected celestial objects, the active object and selected orbit points.
Importing restores selected points and remains compatible with older Location files.
Equally sized symbols distinguish selected points from their antipodes, with a neutral day/night counter.
Antipode markers have transparent interiors in the sky and camera views, consistently with photos and panoramas.
Tutorial taps leave real selections and antipodes unchanged. The camera demonstration affects only tutorial controls.
Clearer point and antipode notifications. Short toggles no longer vibrate; holding still clears selected points with feedback.
